value-4.chars: a handle drag moves that edge by whole bars, the profile keeping its last state until release; Esc mid-drag restores; start never passes end (W-41 once)

kit stand-in (the E19-D03 kit's): the engine bakes the HVN / LVN triangles into the bar instance; the board draws them as the characters ▶ / ◀ in type.num.xs
